title: Live fast-path PIPE_DRAWN append (exec.odin) has zero automated coverage — a revert passes CI
evidence: app/input/exec.odin: `append(inp.log, pp.Command{apply_tick = inp.tick + 1, kind = cmd})` ... `if inp.sim_events != nil {` / `append(inp.sim_events, pp.Event{tick = inp.tick + 1, tag = pp.EVENT_TAG_PIPE_DRAWN})` — and harness/parity.odin:202: `// NOTE: sim_events stays NIL here on purpose — the wire-placed cue is an`. `find app -name "*test*"` lists only app/audio, app/qos_panel, app/settings, app/render tests — no app/input test exists, and no test or golden anywhere references `sim_events`.
detail: The seam carrying the whole live==replay wire-cue claim (and the ~50 ms immediacy for wire placement) is app-binary-only. Goldens pin step's emission; deleting the exec.odin append or main.odin wiring stays CI-green.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test driving commit_draw with a wired sim_events buffer asserting one Event{tick = inp.tick+1, tag = PIPE_DRAWN}, mirroring the r5-r7 exec-level pin convention.

title: "audio.dem: ALL FOUR kinds" claim is false — audio.dem never fires NODE_SPAWNED
evidence: harness/run.odin: `// would pass every hash trivially). audio.dem: ALL FOUR kinds (crisis +` / `// arrival + the v2-sound wire + spawn — the recipe draws pipes at 100 ms,` / `// so PIPE_DRAWN fires; add \`growth on\` for spawn coverage... the spawn`. demos/audio.dem body: `seed 4243` / `run 70000ms` / `era 3` — no `growth on` directive (grep -c growth = 1, the header mention only); the run.odin guard block for name == "audio" checks crisis_draws/arrival_draws/wire_draws only, no spawn_draws.
detail: Same false claim repeated in demos/audio.dem:18 ("exercises ALL FOUR kinds in this one golden" then lists three) and _pr_body.md:17. Spawn is only proven by audio_spawn.dem. Misleading under the W3/W4 guards' own doctrine.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the three spots to say audio.dem proves three kinds (crisis/arrival/wire) and audio_spawn.dem proves spawn+wire; remove the dangling "add `growth on`..." fragment.

title: Spawn placeholder is 0.66 s sequential tones, not "layered over ~0.3 s"; exceeds README's 0.2–0.4 s slot spec
evidence: audio.odin .Spawn case: `// tick, layered over ~0.3 s with a gentle tail (announces, never` ... `tone_append(&out, thumps[slot], 0.22, 0.5)` / `tone_append(&out, bodies[slot], 0.30, 0.35)` / `tone_append(&out, ticks[slot], 0.14, 0.28)` — tone_append is append-only (`tone_append :: proc(out: ^[dynamic]f32, freq, dur_s, amp: f32) { n := int(dur_s * SYNTH_SAMPLE_RATE)` ... `append(out, v)`), so duration is 0.22+0.30+0.14 = 0.66 s. assets/audio/README.md:38: `- **Spawn chimes:** 0.2–0.4 s, SOFT (they announce, never alarm) — the`
detail: The three tones play back-to-back (a 0.66 s arpeggio), not layered over ~0.3 s as the comment claims, and the shipped placeholder violates the README's own 0.2–0.4 s slot guidance for real assets.
recommended_fix: Either mix the three tones into one ~0.3 s buffer, or fix the comment + README duration guidance to match the sequential recipe (≤0.7 s).
